g.text: ABI evolution — additive growth keeps the identity; breaking change forks it
Additive evolution — same identity, one binary serves everyone
old consumers keep reading the v1 prefix;
Breaking evolution — new identity, coexistence via negotiation
provider answers BOTH v1 and v2
every producer and consumer rebuilds together
A fork never edits v1 in place: the 16-byte ID
v1 + v2 served side by side,
